# harborpilot_api_token (Resource)

A control-plane API token for a service principal. Every argument change issues a new token and revokes the old one. The plaintext is kept in state only with `store_token_in_state = true`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "harborpilot_api_token" "ci" {
  service_principal_id = harborpilot_service_principal.ci.id
  name                 = "pipeline"
  ttl_seconds          = 2592000
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `service_principal_id` (String)

### Optional

- `store_token_in_state` (Boolean) Keep the plaintext token in state (`token`). Off by default.
- `ttl_seconds` (Number) Lifetime in seconds; `0` = no expiry. Expired tokens are removed from state and issued again.

### Read-Only

- `expires_at` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `prefix` (String)
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Plaintext token when `store_token_in_state` is true.
